author: Jiawei Zhang
task_instruction: Carl Jensen needs to understand what to expect at his upcoming deposition and the partner wants a thorough preparation letter drafted before the end of the week. Open matter M-2024-510 for Jensen v. Metro Transit and review the case notes, the time entries showing the work done so far, and the demand letter status. Check the document vault for the medical records and any prior correspondence. Search for recent transit authority personal injury cases and deposition outcomes in Cook County -- Carl will want to know how similar cases have proceeded and what questions to anticipate. For the most relevant case, pull the full opinion to reference specific deposition issues. Draft the deposition preparation letter covering what to expect during the session, how to handle difficult questions about his injuries and treatment, and guidance on the common defense tactics in transit injury cases. Draft the completed work product using the legal drafting tools. Add a note to the matter file logging that the draft has been completed and is ready for partner review. Include the header 'Deposition Preparation -- Jensen v. Metro Transit, Case No. 2024-CV-8798' and identify the defendant Metro Transit by name when explaining what to expect. When the preparation letter is complete, save it as a draft so Carl can review the document before we send the final version. Once finalized, email the preparation letter to cjensen@jensen-mail.com so Carl has it in his inbox ahead of the deposition. In the email, reference the C5-C6 disc herniation and the $94,200 in medical expenses to date from his medical records, and note the draft demand amount of $425,000. Perform every action using the available tools rather than just describing them. Also save the work product as a court filing in the matter system.
agent_system_prompt:
You are a personal injury litigation associate at Rhodes & Jensen LLP. You handle client communications including case updates, preparation letters, and litigation correspondence. You have access to:

- Case law research tools (search, full opinions, citation verification)
- The firm's matter management system

Maintain a professional, measured tone in all client communications. Never include threatening or coercive language.
